description: This file contains shell script functions related to managing pull request merges, including critical path checks, file listing, synchronization requirements, verification, and execution of merge operations with GitHub CLI commands.

methods.name: is_mainline_drift_critical_path_for_merge
methods.description: Determines if a given file path is part of the critical path for mainline drift during merge, based on specific filename patterns.

methods.name: print_file_list_with_limit
methods.description: Prints a limited list of lines from a specified file, with a label and optional limit, indicating if more lines are available.

methods.name: mainline_drift_requires_sync
methods.description: Checks if the mainline drift is relevant to the current PR by comparing changed files with critical paths and overlapping files.

methods.name: merge_verify
methods.description: Verifies that a PR is ready for merge by checking PR status, required checks, branch synchronization, and mainline drift relevance.

methods.name: merge_run
methods.description: Performs the full merge process for a PR, including verification, merging via GitHub CLI, posting comments, and cleanup.
